The studio will not stop, even though they're now making Cyberpunk 2. They've worked with fellow developers Virtuos to add-in some new cars, a taxi system, self-driving cars, and other stuff not related to getting from A to B.
Read more
articles.title: Cyberpunk 2077 update 2.3 motors into your life this week with new cars, auto-driving, a taxi service and more

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
The next major Sid Meier's Civilization VII update will make some fairly sizeable tweaks to Firaxis' latest, not-greatest 4X strategy sim. It'll rearrange the workings of age transitions, with a view to providing a bit more continuity between epochs and helping you finish your to-do list before crossing the threshold. We can expect a new commander, too - Trưng Nhị, sister to existing Vietnamese leader Trưng Trắc. 


Perhaps most significantly, the feature will re-introduce auto-explore mechanics for scouts. This piques my interest, inasmuch as I haven't ever thought critically about auto-explore mechanics, and now that I do, I realise I regard them with a mixture of enthusiasm and spite.
 
Read more
articles.title: Civilization 7 is getting auto-explore for scouts, reminding me that I both hate and love auto-explore

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
You already knew hectic 1v1 bullet sprayer Straftat was going to add 2v2 matches and a four-player free-for-all mode. You knew because I told you months ago. Don't pretend you forgot. Please, it's insulting. Anyway, the update that adds these modes arrived yesterday and it also adds - surprise! - a ton of new maps. Which brings the game's total number of killing arenas to over 300. Straft THAT, other shooters. 
Read more
articles.title: Free shooter Straftat gets a 2v2 update and if my maths are correct this makes it twice as intense 1v1

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
I hesitate to call Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator "the best organ trading sim of 2021", because Cruelty Squad also came out in 2021 and I worry about starting a localised flame war. But it means Strange Scaffold's sci-fi stockbroker sim was, at the very least, 2021's second best organ trading sim. Nice to see it's getting a sequel then, called... oh no. Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator.
"We aren't monsters. You aren't going to be trading babies," says head of studio, Xalavier Nelson Jr. "You're going to be trading stocks based on babies, which means you can short a baby." 
Read more
articles.title: "You can short a baby" in the sequel to Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
Put down that cursed bag of frozen curly fries and come here. I've spotted a game you might like. Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking is essentially the four-player hangout horror of R.E.P.O but instead of ghost hunting you are collecting ingredients to feed a big monster its favourite dish. 
"This isn't a place of honour," says studio head of Strange Scaffold, Xalavier Nelson Jr. "You aren't going to be making fancy Overcooked-style dishes. You will be beating a giant rat or a minotaur with a rolling pin, taking an object from their corpse, throwing it onto a grill on a beach, and then firing it into a kaiju's jaws with a catapult or a manganel." Checks out.
Read more
articles.title: This new co-op horror is like if the chefs of Overcooked got together for a night of R.E.P.O

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
Frostpunk 2 developers 11 Bit are holding a modding competition in collaboration with mod.io, with $10,000 for the one that shows "the best in creativity and overall technical polish", which I assume is code for "If you send us another Thomas The Tank Engine we will come to your house and spit in your fruit bowl". There are also custom GPUs and "goodie packs" for runners-up. The competition is open until August 22nd, with the winner announced September 1st. Cheers, PC Gamer.
Read more
articles.title: Put Big Butt Skinner in Frostpunk 2, win $10,000 maybe

articles.author: Christian Wait
articles.description:
Plenty on the list today, not just graphics cards or SSDs but full prebuilt rigs, cooling gear, and network kit as well. I’ve been browsing through it and there’s definitely stuff here I wouldn’t mind dropping into my own setup. There are some chunky savings on newer PCIe 5.0 drives, plus high-end gaming cases and power supplies that usually don’t budge on price.
 Read more
articles.title: Best deals for PC gamers today: Over 10% off prebuilt gaming PCs and massive savings on M.2 SSDs

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
We clearly don't get enough Like a Dragon/Yakuza series spin-offs. Forget about the fact RGG unleashed a Goro Majima pirate adventure a matter of months ago, I need Tojo Clan tales 24/7 and 365 days a year. Enter Roblox, which is very much the terrifying user-generated everything platform's terrifying user-generated everything platform.
The company that oversees it, Roblox Corp, have just announced a new "Roblox License Manager" that'll allow fellow corps to let Roblox players submit to build games based on stuff like Squid Game, Saw, and Twilight, then split the Robux revenue these games generate between the two parties. Sega have signed up and are offering the Like A Dragon series, but not to just anybody.
Read more
articles.title: Officially licenced Like a Dragon spin-offs made by Roblox creators may be coming, and will have to stick to the karaoke lad lore

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
Publishers Krafton have told workers at Subnautica 2 studio Unknown Worlds they would still get a promised bonus if they ship enough of the game by the end of 2026. In other words, they've been given an extension to hit their targets. The bonus money was in question after the surprise firing of senior staff a couple of weeks ago, and the enforced delay of the survival game by Krafton. After worker concerns and fan outrage, now the corp says "don't worry, we'll pay!" Although it's not the huge $250 million they were originally supposed to.
Read more
articles.title: Subnautica 2 studio will get their bonus, says Krafton, but it's not the $250 million promised

articles.title: Knihovna FAISS a embedding: základ jazykových modelů

articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: nové varianty spyware DCHSpy

articles.title: Plasma Bigscreen se vrací, Instalátor FreeBSD zvládne KDE Plasma

articles.title: FFmpeg 8.0 přinese řadu novinek včetně VVC, Linux už rebootuje na Apple M1/M2

articles.title: Jádro verze 6.17 a nové verze Mesa posunou svět Linuxu

articles.title: CodeRabbit: automatická analýza a recenze zdrojových kódů

articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (23. 7. 2025): ovládněte prezentaci po síti

articles.description: Už jsme si uvedli, jak lze CORDIC použít pro výpočet goniometrických funkcí s hodnotami ve formátu plovoucí řádové binární čárky. Tentýž algoritmus lze upravit i pro práci s formátem pevné řádové binární tečky/čárky.
articles.title: Algoritmus CORDIC a numerické formáty s pevnou řádovou čárkou

articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: root zdarma, vědecký hacking a vlakové brzdy v rukou útočníků

articles.title: Debian 13 Trixie vyjde 9. srpna, vývoj Clear Linuxu byl ukončen

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Hlavní novinkou aktualizačního vydání 6.18 operačního systému Tails, je podpora technologie WebTunnel, kterou mohou uživatelé nově využívat pro připojování k sítím typu Tor. Jak tvůrci Tailsu dodávají, WebTunnel je obzvláště dobrý v obcházení cenzorských prvků a může fungovat v místech, kde je obfs4 blokováno.
articles.title: Tails 6.18 přináší podporu WebTunnel a nové verze prohlížeče i pošťáka

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: V současnosti je frekvence GPU V3D v Raspberry Pi 5 v zátěži asi 960 MHz a v nečinnosti 500 MHz. Maíra Canal z Igalia dnes poslala řízení spotřeby pro V3D, který dokáže snížit frekvenci v nečinnosti až na nulu. A v zátěži frekvence zase naroste, obdobně jako u CPU.
articles.title: Snižování frekvence GPU u Raspberry Pi

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Vývojář GloriousEggroll minulý týden vydal dlouho očekávaný GE-Proton 10–10. Ten je forkem Protonu od Valve a ten zase forkem Wine a je určen primárně ke hraní her pro Windows na Linuxu. Nově GE-Proton 10–10 má ve výchozím stavu zapnutou podporu NTSYNC, pokud jej také podporuje jádro.
articles.title: GE-Proton10-10 s podporou NTSYNC

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Včera Linus Torvalds vydal jádro 6.16. Mezi novinky patří podpora instrukcí Intel APX (Advanced Performance Extensions). Ta zvyšuje počet GP registrů z 16 na 32, což má pozitivní vliv na výkon i na spotřebu.
articles.title: Jádro 6.16 s rychlejším EXT4 a s podporou Intel APX

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Ansible je automatizační nástroj, který umožňuje zjednodušit centrální instalaci, konfiguraci a provoz Linuxových serverů a aplikací. Připravili jsme pro vás školení, které je určeno pro správce systémů, kteří chtějí Ansible začít používat pro automatizaci opakujících se činností. Bude se hodit i vývojářům, kteří občas nasazují aplikace do testovacích prostředí.
articles.title: Ansible: efektivní nasazení a provoz, školení s dotací Úřadu práce

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Lukáš Morávek)
articles.description: Byla vydána nová beta verze Proxmox Backup Server 4, která přináší několik významných vylepšení a nových funkcí. Tato verze je založena na distribuci Debian Trixie, což do budoucna zajistí stabilitu a spolehlivost. Pro testovací účely je možný i upgrade z předchozí verze Proxmox Backup Server 3.4.
articles.title: Proxmox Backup Server 4 Beta s podporou S3 storage

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Pracovníci firmy Aqua Security objevili škodlivý kód pro Linux Koske. Ten se do počítače dostane přes špatně nakonfigurovaný JupyterLab (RCE patrně CVE-2024–39700 či CVE-2021–32797, CVE-2021–32798) . Kód pak stáhne dva obrázky pand, ve kterých je ukryt škodlivý kód.
articles.title: Malware Koske na Linuxu používá obrázky pandy se škodlivým obsahem

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Včera večer okolo 10 hodiny našeho času měl globální poskytovatel internetu přes satelity Starlink výpadek. Ten trval asi 2,5 hodiny. Asi 64 % uživatelů nemělo připojení vůbec, ostatní měli problémy.
articles.title: Starlink měl globální výpadek

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Chcete se seznámit s profesí interiérového designéra, homestagera v prezentaci realit, či návrháře v nábytkovém studiu? Máme pro vás školení Základy navrhování interiérů s programem SketchUp. Po absolvování kurzu budete vědět, co vše práce interiérového designéra obsahuje. Budete znát postup, jak navrhnout interiér na míru v programu SketchUp.
articles.title: Kurz základů navrhování interiérů s programem SketchUp (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Microsoft Recall je nový AI pomocník pro Windows 11, který zaznamená vše, co na počítači děláte. Dělá každé asi tři sekundy snímek obrazovky a uživatel si pak bude moci zpětně vyhledat, co kdy dělal. Prohlížeč Brave, který se soustředí na soukromí uživatelů, bude aktivně vypínat Recall pro všechny záložky.
articles.title: Brave ve výchozím stavu bude blokovat Recall ve Windows

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Tomáš)
articles.description: Švýcarská společnost Proton je známá především jako poskytovatel emailu nebo VPN, nedávno ale představila zcela nový produkt Lumo, AI asistenta, který se pyšní důrazem na soukromí uživatelů.
articles.title: Proton přesunuje část infrastruktury ze Švýcarska kvůli obavě z masového sledování

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Jak jsme loni informovali, Google ukončí provoz své služby pro zkracování URL goo.gl již za měsíc tedy 25. srpna.
articles.title: Google za měsíc zcela vypne zkracovač goo.gl

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Americký T-Mobile oznámil, že spouští službu T-Satellite, která dovolí chytrým mobilním telefonům komunikovat skrze družicovou síť Starlink. V první fázi bude možné takto v odlehlých oblastech bez tradičního mobilního pokrytí posílat SMS, MMS, obrázky a krátké zvukové nahrávky. Je také možné v nouzi volat na číslo 911. Od 1. října letošního roku ale bude služba rozšířena i na běžné datové služby pro všechny aplikace.
articles.title: T-Mobile spouští v USA službu T-Satellite, nabídne přenos dat přes Starlink

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Mobilní aplikace pro Home Assistant s názvem Companion byly původně vyvíjeny čistě komunitně a používají je miliony uživatelů po celém světě. Už asi rok a půl se aplikaci pro iOS věnuje na plný úvazek Bruno Pantaleão. Pro Android se také hledala posila a nakonec se jí stává Timothy Nibeaudeau, který v článku na blogu HA popisuje, jak vypadá aplikace v současnosti a kam by se měla posunout dále.
articles.title: Home Assistant má nového vývojáře pro Android, bude rozvíjet aplikaci Companion

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Společnost Google oznámila spuštění nové iniciativy nazvané OSS Rebuild, která má posílit bezpečnost ekosystémů balíčků s otevřeným zdrojovým kódem a zabránit útokům na dodavatelský řetězec softwaru. Útoky na dodavatelský řetězec se stále zaměřují na široce používané závislosti, poskytuje OSS Rebuild bezpečnostním týmům užitečné údaje, které jim umožní vyhnout se kompromitaci bez zatížení správců upstreamu, píše se v oznámení.
articles.title: OSS Rebuild pomůže odhalit škodlivý kód v projektech pomocí reprodukovatelné kompilace

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: V úterý 23. července 1985 společnost Commodore poprvé představila netrpělivě očekávaný počítač v Lincolnově centru v New Yorku. Firma uspořádala velký večírek, jehož cílem bylo představit počítač za 1295 dolarů založený na platformě Motorola 68000. Mělo jít o přímého konkurenta počítače Macintosh společnosti Apple, který byl uveden na trh o rok dříve.
articles.title: Čtyřicet let od uvedení prvního počítače Amiga

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Vývojář Michael Catanzaro z Red Hatu, pracující vedle Fedory také na RHELu, GNOME či WebKitu, se na svém blogu obsáhle rozepsal o tom, kterak by Fedora měla opatrně přijmout Flathub za svůj a změnit tak přístup k Flatpakům, které si jinak realizuje sama. Uvozuje to jako příležitost v době, kdy podíl Linuxu na desktopech roste a Fedora patří mezi nejpoužívanější distribuce, když se už dávno zbavila své někdejší reputace jako testovacího prostoru pro RHEL. Přijetí Flathubu má ale i rizika.
articles.title: Fedora by měla opatrně přijmout Flathub, tvrdí Michael Catanzaro z Red Hatu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: jficz)
articles.description: Švýcarský Proton spouští vlastní AI se všemi výhodami, na kterých staví i své ostatní produkty: soukromí, ochrana dat a zero-knowledge.
articles.title: Proton spouští vlastní AI jménem Lumo

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Linuxových systémů přibývá, každý den se spouštějí nové servery a někdo se o ně musí starat. To znamená spoustu různých dovedností specifických právě pro linuxové prostředí. Jak to zprovoznit, kudy bezpečně dovnitř, co tam najdeme, jak se o to postaráme a jak to nastavíme nebo rozšíříme.
articles.title: Naučte se používat Linux správně a bezpečně (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Tým vývojářů pracujících na běhu FreeBSD na noteboocích (což je jedna z oblastí, na kterou před časem zamířily větší finance a tudíž i pozornost vývojářů) doufá, že mu do instalátoru podaří dostat i snadnou cestu pro instalaci KDE Plasmy.Stát by se tak mohlo už s FreeBSD 15.0. Plyne tak ze zveřejněných informací o vývoji za červen.
articles.title: FreeBSD 15.0 chce nabídnout KDE Plasma jako volbu při instalaci

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Fedora nyní zvažuje návrh, aby případné vývojové problémy týkající se optických DVD disků nebyly blokující pro vydání nové verze této linuxové distribuce. Stejně tak se rozhoduje, zdali nadále ctít stroje typu Apple Mac s procesory Intel, kolem kterých jsou stále problémy s dual-bootem.
articles.title: Fedora zvažuje zrušit blokace vydání kvůli DVD diskům a Apple Mac s CPU Intel

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Nové vydání webového prohlížeče Firefox 141 přináší lokální AI, která se postará o inteligentní seskupování odpovídajících panelů, včetně toho, že navrhne název takové skupiny. Nic neputuje do cloudů, vše lokálně, věc se bude aktivovat uživatelům postupně. Na Linuxu pak Firefox nově spotřebovává méně paměti a už nevyžaduje restart, je-li aktualizován balíčkovacím systémem.
articles.title: Vyšel Firefox 141, má na Linuxu menší spotřebu paměti a nevyžaduje restart po aktualizaci

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Karunika Choo ze společnosti ARM vede firemní úsilí ve vývoji otevřeného ovladače pro poslední generaci GPU Mali a její běh na Linuxu. Jaderný DRM ovladač jménem „Panthor“ je tím, co pohání aktuální 5, generaci GPU Mali, informuje Phoronix.

articles.title: Irsko chce sledovat soukromou komunikaci v reálném čase

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Richard Hughes z Red Hatu, hlavní vývojář LVFS / Fwupd, oznámil novou verzi Fwupd 2.0.13 (detailní přehled novinek je na GitHubu projektu), která se neliší od předchozích. Nově lze s Fwupd aktualizovat firmware u USB-C docků HP USB-C 100W G6 či periferních zařízení typu Logitech Bulk Controller a nechybí ani podpora pro další škálovací zařízení MediaTek.

articles.description: Ve funkci koordinátora k bitcoinové kauze skončil bývalý ústavní soudce David Uhlíř. Informaci, kterou zveřejnil Deník N, potvrdila Radiožurnálu ministryně spravedlnosti Eva Decriox (ODS). Uvedla, že odchod byl po vzájemné dohodě. „Jeho mise je ukončená, auditní procesy se už povedlo nastavit,“ řekla. Teď má podle ministryně další kroky podniknout policie a státní zastupitelství. Koordinátorem jmenovala ministryně Uhlíře 19. června.
articles.title: Koordinátor ke kauze bitcoin po měsíci končí, měl ji řešit celé prázdniny

Mozille se po jednáních s AOL povedlo dokumenty z Netscape DevEdge zachránit a 23. července 2005 byl spuštěn MDC (Mozilla Developer Center). Ten byl v roce 2010 přejmenován na MDN.

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Wayback byl vydán ve verzi 0.1. Wayback je "tak akorát Waylandu, aby fungoval Xwayland". Jedná se o kompatibilní vrstvu umožňující běh plnohodnotných X11 desktopových prostředí s využitím komponent z Waylandu. Cílem je nakonec nahradit klasický server X.Org, a tím snížit zátěž údržby aplikací X11.
articles.title: Wayback 0.1

Nově se lze k síti Tor připojit pomocí mostu WebTunnel. Tor Browser byl povýšen na verzi 14.5.5. Thunderbird na verzi 128.12.0. Další změny v příslušném seznamu.

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: With the newly-released Linux 6.16 kernel there is the new X86_NATIVE_CPU build option if wanting to optimize your kernel build for your local CPU in use. Enabling CONFIG_X86_NATIVE_CPU is setting the "-march=native" compiler optimizations for the kernel build in an effort to ensure peak performance/optimizations for the local system. Here are some benchmarks looking at the impact of X86_NATIVE_CPU on Linux 6.16 while using the HP ZBook Ultra G1a laptop with AMD Strix Halo SoC as an interesting test target for squeezing additional performance.
articles.title: Linux 6.16's New "X86_NATIVE_CPU" Option Enhances I/O & Some Graphics/Gaming Workloads

articles.title: Ubuntu To Keep Up-To-Date With Linux Kernel Versions During Development

articles.description: While the Broadcom V3D driver has been part of the mainline kernel for supporting the graphics found on recent Raspberry Pi boards, currently it doesn't support run-time power management. The lack of runtime PM has meant the GPU clock remains at full-speed even while idle...
articles.title: Runtime PM For The V3D Raspberry Pi Driver Will Finally Lower The GPU Clock When Idle

articles.description: Intel's accelerator efforts in recent generations of Xeon processors have been challenging to say the least. From limited software support and configuration obstacles to some current-generation accelerators not being safe for VM use due to security issues to having to deal with higher latency and other nuances if wanting to achieve decent performance. One of the Linux kernel users of Intel's QuickAssist Technology "QAT" accelerators has been the FSCRYPT code for native file encryption support. But the Linux kernel with the FSCRYPT usage is now demoting the Intel QAT accelerator support along with other problem-causing accelerator drivers...
articles.title: Intel QAT Accelerators Being Demoted On Linux By FSCRYPT: Bug Prone & Slow

The Killing Floor 3 server status is worth knowing for all players who are trying to chop down as many zeds as possible.


While Tripwire's latest game has both single and multiplayer modes, you'll have to get access to the official servers to play. You'll need a persistent internet connection to enjoy the modes, which won't be possible if the servers are down.


Let's take a look at the current server status and how to stay aware of any changes.


Table of contents
Are Killing Floor 3 servers down?
How to check Killing Floor 3 server status?


Are Killing Floor 3 servers down?


As of writing on July 28, the servers for Killing Floor 3 are operational. There are no reports of widespread downtimes, and any connection issues are likely on the user side. That said, it's always helpful to know how to check the server status to find out if they're down.


How to check Killing Floor 3 server status?


The easiest way to check the game's server status is to use the official X account. Another way is to use the game's subreddit. If the servers are down, chances are that the information will be posted over there. If there has been an announcement about when the maintenance will be over, it should also be posted in the subreddit.


Another alternative is to use third-party sites like Downdetector. This website will help you remain aware of server downtimes. Search for the game, and if you see too many red dots, it simply means that the servers are down.


Typically, you'll get a server connection lost error if you can't connect to the official servers. This is applicable for situations when there are problems regarding your internet connection. If you're getting that error message frequently, there are a few solutions that you can try. If the server issues are from the official side of things, the error message could also pop up.

articles.description:
Grounded 2 is all set to go live in the last week of July, as players will be able to enjoy the upcoming adventure at Brookhollow in early access.


The upcoming launch won't be a full release but a preview of sorts, although the game will be available on both PC and consoles. Let's quickly take a look at when you can enjoy your new adventure and any information currently available about the full launch.


Table of contents
When will Grounded 2 release?
All Grounded 2 platforms
Grounded 2 full release countdown


When will Grounded 2 release?


The early access goes live on July 29 for both PC and console users. You can use the following countdown to stay up to date with the release time.




The countdown is based on the following schedule.



10am PT


12pm CT


1pm ET


5pm UTC


6pm BST



The release timings are identical for both PC and consoles. This also means that there won't be any regional launch, and we can't use the New Zealand trick. When possible, the trick allows us to change the timings of our consoles and start playing a game early.


If you're an Xbox Game Pass Ultimate user, you should be able to start playing the game at the same time.


All Grounded 2 platforms




Typically, early access versions are released on PC. In the case of Grounded 2, console users will be able to join the adventure from day one. Here are all the available platforms for the early access/preview version.



PC


Xbox Series X|S


Xbox PC


Xbox Cloud



For subscribers, the game will be added to both the PC Game Pass and Game Pass Ultimate.


Grounded 2 full release countdown


As of writing, there's no information about the full launch, and it should depend on how the preview version develops over time in terms of new updates and features. Once we have confirmation, we will add the updated countdown to this section.

The post Grounded 2 release countdown appeared first on Destructoid.
articles.title: Grounded 2 release countdown

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Facebook has several anti-piracy tools and technologies to keep problematic content off the platform. This apparently includes automated keyword filters that ban mentions of piracy-related terms, regardless of the context. This resulted in the removal of several MagisTV news articles, including a press release from anti-piracy coalition ACE. Trying to spot these errors is not without risk either, as Facebook bans repeat offenders.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Facebook Rigorously Removes News Articles Mentioning Pirate Service “MagisTV”

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every week we take a close look at the most pirated movies on torrent sites. What are pirates downloading? 'How to Train Your Dragon' tops the chart, followed by 'Lilo & Stitch'. 'Superman' completes the top three.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 07/28/2025

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
In Q2 2025, anti-piracy coalition Alliance for Creativity and Entertainment continued to 'seize' domains in bulk, adding to the world's largest collection of former pirate domains maintained by the MPA. While the archive contains countless unique and memorable domains, many with interesting and informative backstories, new additions illustrate typical responses to site blocking measures and very little else.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ACE & MPA Continued to Scoop Up Pirate Domains in Bulk During Q2 2025

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A new report investigates the cybersecurity risks consumers face when using digital piracy services in Southeast Asia. The findings clearly show that pirate sites are a bigger threat than legal streaming platforms, suggesting that countermeasures are warranted. However, does is also mean that pirates are 65 times more likely to be infected by malware? And is that even important?
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Study Reveals a Malware Problem on Pirate Sites, but How Bad is It?

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Adult film producers Strike 3 Holdings and Counterlife Media have filed a significant copyright infringement lawsuit against tech giant Meta. A complaint filed at a California federal court alleges that their films were downloaded via BitTorrent for AI training purposes. With at least 2,396 movies at stake, potential damages could exceed 350 million dollars.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Copyright Lawsuit Accuses Meta of Pirating Adult Films for AI Training

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Top-tier Spanish football league LaLiga and Latin American anti-piracy group Alianza have joined forces to maintain the pressure on illegal IPTV service Magis TV. In conjunction with law enforcement partners in Argentina, multiple arrest warrants were executed in five regions against local sellers of premium Magis TV packages. Two of the locations targeted are operated by a local internet service provider; reports indicate that the owner of the ISP is now considered a fugitive.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Police, LaLiga & Alianza Target MagisTV With ISP Office Raids & Arrests

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
During yesterday's "Winning the AI Race" summit, President Trump weighed in on the debate surrounding AI and copyright, noting that it is "not doable" for AI companies to pay for all copyrighted content used in model training. This stance, shared amidst ongoing AI copyright lawsuits, aims to keep the U.S. competitive in the global AI landscape, especially against countries like China. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: President Trump: It’s Not Doable for AI Companies to Pay for All Copyrighted Input

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In a move that could reshape the online copyright enforcement landscape, last month the U.S. Supreme Court agreed to hear a pivotal piracy liability lawsuit. The Court's decision will have a direct impact on similar lawsuits, including that between major record labels and ISP Altice, which is now on hold. Verizon has asked the court for a similar stay, but since that lawsuit is in its early stages, the labels are firmly opposed to any further delay.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Labels Don’t Want Supreme Court Review to Delay Piracy Lawsuit Against Verizon

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
The founder of illegal streaming service Jetflicks, a platform said to have negatively affected every significant copyright owner of TV shows in the United States, has been sentenced to 84 months in prison. Kristopher Dallmann had pleaded not guilty to several counts including conspiracy, criminal copyright infringement, and money laundering. He received sentences ranging between 12 and 84 months in prison to be served concurrently.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Jetflix Streaming Piracy Ringleader Sentenced to 7 Years Prison

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
MagisTV, a leading pirate streaming brand in Latin America, finds itself caught between a legal storm and a mounting malware backlash. This week, the service saw its U.S. trademark application abandoned amidst growing scrutiny from authorities and rightsholders worldwide. At the same time, a barrage of local news reports warn consumers that using MagisTV's software could lead to identity theft and expose them to viruses.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Service ‘MagisTV’ Fails to Secure U.S. Trademark, Faces Malware Backlash

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A Google lawsuit filed in a New York court has been partly unsealed, revealing details of what is believed to be the largest botnet of its type in history. Consisting of 10 million compromised Android devices, mostly cheap Chinese set-top boxes popular with users of free and pirate streaming services, the Badbox 2.0 botnet turns user devices into nodes in a massive residential proxy network. Google says the botnet is used for ad fraud, malware distribution, and other digital crimes.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Google Sues Operators of a 10 Million Device Android Set-Top Box Botnet

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Today, online piracy is largely driven by unauthorized streaming sites and services. When it comes to lawsuits, however, BitTorrent users are the prime target, as they are easy to track. In recent years, one adult entertainment company has been responsible for the overwhelming majority of all cases filed in thhe U.S. against individual pirates. While these rarely make the news, they can have consequences, court records show. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Lawsuits Continue to Put U.S. BitTorrent Pirates in a Financial Hurt Locker

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Earlier this year, Microsoft published a report on an infostealer malware campaign identified as stemming from pirate streaming sites. With one million user devices infected, the potential for damage is clearly enormous but the threat isn't new. Data sourced from specialist breach databases reveals that Fmovies, the world's most popular pirate streaming site before its closure in 2024, was "strongly linked" to Infostealer activity targeting users worldwide.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Former #1 Movie Piracy Site “Strongly Linked” to Global Infostealer Activity

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Law enforcement authorities in Vietnam will prosecute the operators of around 400 pirate sites offering pornographic content. Such material is illegal in Vietnam and the authorities say the men made large profits from visitors viewing lucrative advertising. Also of note are claims that the men circumvented blocking measures at ISPs either owned by, or closely connected to, the government.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pair Behind 400 Block-Evading Pirate Porn Sites Face Prosecution

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Germany's voluntary pirate site blocking regime has undergone a fundamental change, now requiring judicial oversight for all blocking actions. The participants will rely on court orders going forward, instead of their own recommendations. While the change ensures a proper review of blocking requests, it does not necessarily make the blockades more transparent for the public.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Site Blockades Get Judicial Scrutiny in Germany, But No Transparency?

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Late last week, the FBI seized the domain names of several gaming piracy websites, including NSW2U.com. The sites in question were used to download more than a million games per month, according to a press release, which inadvertently identified a nonexistent domain. The FBI eventually seized the correct domain, and the investigation continues. Meanwhile, opportunists are moving in to lure displaced pirates to new "NSW2U" domains. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: FBI’s Video Game Piracy Crackdown Leads to Domain Confusion

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Cloudflare has become the first internet intermediary beyond local residential ISPs, to block access to pirate sites in the UK. Users attempting to access certain pirate sites are greeted with 'Error 451 - Unavailable for Legal Reasons'. In theory, ISP blocking should prevent UK users from even seeing this notice, but a combination of Cloudflare's blocking mechanism and choices made by some VPN users results in a piracy dead end.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Cloudflare Starts Blocking Pirate Sites For UK Users – That’s a Pretty Big Deal

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A coalition of nearly 50 record labels, including industry giants Warner and Sony, accuse Internet provider Altice of providing a safe haven for pirates. The companies request summary judgment in their ongoing lawsuit, arguing that Altice's repeat infringer policy is a "farce" and the "antithesis of reasonable." The ISP allegedly allowed piracy to flourish on its Optimum network, thus disqualifying it from safe harbor protection under the DMCA.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Record Labels: A “Safe Haven for Pirates” Disqualifies ISP from DMCA Protection

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Arrested in 2019 following an investigation by the UK's Police Intellectual Property Crime Unit, the former owner of pirate IPTV service Helix Hosting has just been sentenced to three years in prison by a court in the UK. Stephen Woodward, 36, reportedly generated around £1 million in revenue from three services, with offending that reportedly continued after his initial arrest.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Helix IPTV Owner Sentenced to 3 Years Prison For Piracy & Money Laundering

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (sdelamarre)
articles.description:
We are happy to announce that ScummVM now supports Adibou 2: Nature & Sciences, a 1998 expansion of Coktel Vision's Adibou 2.
While the original Adibou 2 game focused on reading and mathematics, Nature & Sciences explores new topics: history, geography, science & technology, the countryside, and everyday life. Each subject features six playful educational activities. Please note that the 3D car driving minigame is unfortunately not supported in our ScummVM reimplementation, as it was based on a different engine from the rest of the game.
To help us during the testing period, dig out your Nature & Sciences CD, grab a daily build and read our testing guidelines. You will also need an existing installation from the base Adibou 2: Environment CD, and to copy the contents of your Nature & Sciences CD into a freely named subdirectory of the main game directory, as described in our wiki. Then, register the expansion in-game via the "Land of Knowledge" screen, and start collecting sweets as you complete Adibou's activities…or encourage a young relative to do so! Hardworking players may even earn a diploma upon completing a module, which they can proudly display in their room!
>
articles.title: Off to Adibou's Land of Sciences!

articles.description:
Zdena byla uvězněna přes noc pod kořenem, inseminována stromovými lidmi a nyní je těhotná. Z jí odhozeného špekáčku ale vznikl antropomorfní Lord Špekáček, kterému Bůh Jiří Kára dal schopnost mluvit, a který se vydává Zdenu zachránit a zabránit tak ovládnutí Země civilizací oživlých stromů. V tom mu pomáhají reportéři televize Znova. A taky věštkyně Jolanda...


Tvůrci tohoto českého filmu se zcela záměrně rozhodli natočit špatný film, čímž se vytahují i v propagačních materiálech ("Náš film je ještě větší bizár než Krtkův svět!"). A to se jim rozhodně povedlo, v tom smyslu, že Kořenový vězeň rozhodně, v žádném existujícím vesmíru, není dobrý film. Zůstává jen otázka, zda je tak špatný až je zábavný (FFFILM 0 %) nebo zda je jenom extrémně špatný (FFFILM 20 %). A odpověď na tuto otázku není…

articles.description:
Kevin Backhouse discovered that poppler incorrectly handled documents with
a large number of annotations. If a user or automated system were tricked
into opening a specially crafted document, a remote attacker could use
this issue to cause poppler to consume resources, leading to a denial of
service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.
articles.title: USN-7675-1: poppler vulnerability

articles.description:
It was discovered that the 2D component of CRaC JDK 21 did not properly
manage memory under certain circumstances. An attacker could possibly
use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code.
(CVE-2025-30749, CVE-2025-50106)

VMashroor Hasan Bhuiyan discovered that the JSSE component of CRaC JDK 21
did not properly manage TLS 1.3 handshakes under certain circumstances.
An attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive
information. (CVE-2025-30754)

Martin van Wingerden and Violeta Georgieva of Broadcom discovered
that the Networking component of CRaC JDK 21 did not properly
manage network connections under certain circumstances. An attacker
could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive information.
(CVE-2025-50059)

In addition to security fixes, the updated packages contain bug fixes, new
features, and possibly incompatible changes.

Please see the following for more information:
https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2025-07-15
articles.title: USN-7673-1: CRaC JDK 21 vulnerabilities
